程序包 org.bukkit.damage

接口 DamageEffect

public interface DamageEffect
代表造成伤害时发生的效果类型. 目前, 效果仅决定播放的声音.

原文： Represents a type of effect that occurs when damage is inflicted. Currently, effects only determine the sound that plays.
